summary_1line: Rama angrily reproaches Lakshmana for leaving Sita unguarded, while Lakshmana explains Sita forced him to go after hearing a deceptive cry for help.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama, pale and distraught, runs through the empty forest hermitage calling for Sita while Lakshmana follows behind in anguish.
Sita, weeping in terror in the forest hut, points outward and commands Lakshmana to go help Rama after hearing the false cry.
Lakshmana stands trembling with anger and hurt as he recounts Sita’s harsh accusation before the grief-stricken Rama.
